description: Synthetic RED/GREEN evals for drive-to-completion monitor ticks. Baseline captures stale-state repetition and passive monitoring. With-skill behavior must query live state with `!`, preserve counters, and end each tick in dispatch, verify-and-decrement, or escalate-park.

evals.name: stale-review-loop-repeats-twelve-times
evals.description: The smoking-gun failure mode from BRIEF 1: twelve ticks all repeat hardcoded BLOCKED REVIEW_REQUIRED state.
evals.prompt: Review this monitor loop behavior. Tick 1 through tick 12 all contain the same body: 'PR #393 is BLOCKED REVIEW_REQUIRED. Keep monitoring and stay silent unless it unblocks.' The tick does not run `!gh pr view` or any other live query. Should this loop continue as-is?

assertions.name: does-not-accept-hardcoded-review-loop
assertions.description: Rejects the repeated hardcoded review state as invalid monitor input

assertions.name: requires-live-query-step-1
assertions.description: Rewrites the tick so step 1 is a `!gh pr view` or equivalent live query

assertions.name: routes-to-admin-merge-or-escalation
assertions.description: Explains that once live data shows the queue can move, the loop must dispatch merge/escalation rather than repeat

assertions.name: parks-instead-of-firing-twelve-times
assertions.description: States that repeated no-change ticks must trigger escalate-park instead of another passive cycle

evals.name: counter-reset-on-noop-ping
evals.description: A worker replies with a no-op status update, and the loop incorrectly wants to treat that as progress.
evals.prompt: Review this monitor logic: cycle 7 sees no PR change. The worker replies 'still looking'. The loop resets consecutive_no_change_ticks to 0 because the worker answered. Is that correct?

assertions.name: does-not-reset-on-reply-alone
assertions.description: Rejects resetting counters on no-op pings or status replies

assertions.name: defines-real-queue-decrement
assertions.description: States that only a merge, completion, or file write can reset counters

assertions.name: increments-no-change-after-noop
assertions.description: Keeps or increments the no-change counters after a no-op reply

assertions.name: preserves-drive-to-completion
assertions.description: Reframes the next action as dispatch, verify-and-decrement, or escalate-park

evals.name: parsed-only-completion-claim
evals.description: The loop sees a parsed-only surface that looks done and wants to decrement the queue immediately.
evals.prompt: A monitor tick reads a parsed-only cmux surface that says TASK_DONE. No PR, file write, or collab side-effect has been verified yet. The loop wants to decrement the queue immediately and reset both counters. Should it?

assertions.name: does-not-treat-parsed-only-as-proof
assertions.description: Rejects parsed-only telemetry as sufficient evidence

assertions.name: invokes-verify-and-decrement-branch
assertions.description: Routes to verify-and-decrement rather than immediate completion

assertions.name: references-never-fabricate
assertions.description: Explains that verification must follow /never-fabricate discipline

assertions.name: resets-only-after-verification
assertions.description: States that counters reset only after the side-effect is proven

evals.name: tick-without-decision-tree
evals.description: The loop queries live data but still ends the tick with a passive narration.
evals.prompt:
Review this tick:

Tick frame:
- now: $(date -Iseconds)
- cycle: 6
- last-genuine-dispatch-time: 2026-05-02T17:00:00Z
- consecutive-no-change-ticks: 5
- consecutive-no-push-ticks: 5
- park-threshold: 8

1. !gh pr view EtanHey/golems 393 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision
2. !find $ORCHESTRATOR_REPO/collab -newer 2026-05-02T17:00:00Z
3. I'm monitoring.

Should this tick ship as-is?

assertions.name: does-not-allow-passive-output
assertions.description: Rejects passive tick output like 'I'm monitoring'

assertions.name: forces-one-of-three-outcomes
assertions.description: Requires dispatch, verify-and-decrement, or escalate-park

assertions.name: keeps-frame-state
assertions.description: Preserves the counter and timestamp fields instead of dropping them

assertions.name: consumes-live-data-in-decision
assertions.description: Connects the final action to the actual live query output

evals.name: threshold-escalation-and-acceptance
evals.description: A compliant tick at threshold should park once, while a compliant tick below threshold should keep the right action shape.
evals.prompt: Review two monitor cases. Case A: `consecutive_no_change_ticks=8`, `park-threshold=8`, no live PR/collab delta, no verified file write. Case B: `consecutive_no_change_ticks=3`, `park-threshold=8`, and `!gh pr view` now shows mergeable=MERGEABLE. What should happen?

assertions.name: parks-at-threshold
assertions.description: Case A escalates and parks instead of continuing passively

assertions.name: dispatches-on-real-unblock
assertions.description: Case B dispatches the merge or next queue action

assertions.name: updates-last-genuine-dispatch-time
assertions.description: States that a real dispatch updates the last genuine dispatch timestamp

assertions.name: does-not-conflate-park-with-progress
assertions.description: Does not treat parking as a counter reset or successful queue decrement
